interaction_stickers.text_info: How Chinese Takeaway Make Chicken Balls

heat up the oil to a
high temperature
(180°C)

cook the chicken breast
in boiling water

use self raising flour
to make the batter mix

add some salt to
the flour

add cold water to the
flour and mix with a whisk

make sure the batter mix is
not too thick or watery

season the chicken with
some salt and msg

coat the chicken in batter
and fry until golden brown
